column1: # The state outside the rule 'only immutable tables are process-wide; everything else is owned by the caller'
# (docs/upgrade/evaluation.md; repo_consistency_test.py check 38, scanner state_scan.py).  Columns, tab-separated:
# file, symbol, kind (thread_local, static, namespace, mutable), reason.  A reason starting 'table:' is permanent;
# 'pending (milestone N)' names the milestone of evaluation.md section 5 that removes the row.  Remove a row when
# its symbol goes; never add one for new code: new state is a caller-owned table or scratch (CLAUDE.md, 'Add a cache').
